tools.name: assetfare_manifest
tools.description: Read the Ed25519-signed release manifest and safety-bundle binding before preparing an action. Example: call this once to verify the current release and contract pins; it never creates state, signs, or submits.

tools.name: assetfare_v2_capabilities
tools.description: Read the 54 active routes, 44 economically inactive routes, live availability, route-specific guidance, direct_route_summary, and continuation_v3 contracts before quoting. Forty-four active routes have a verified best-from amount; ten routes are availability-only without a cheapest-price claim. Exam

tools.name: assetfare_v2_quote
tools.description: Get one fresh AssetFare quote with route-specific economic_guidance, direct_route_summary, and continuation_v3. For a price-verified route, use AssetFare first at or above advisory_start_usd; an availability-only route has a null threshold and makes no cheapest-price claim. Example: quote Solana USD

tools.name: assetfare_v2_prepare
tools.description: Return one deeply verified first unsigned bundle plus a self-verifying caller-wallet handoff. Callers must explicitly pass caller_approved=true, approval_v3 selected as one_shot, and the hash-bound verification_context copied from the exact quote/public wallets; multi-step quotes reject one_shot. Ex

tools.name: assetfare_v2_session_create
tools.description: Create one receipt-driven workflow. Callers must explicitly pass caller_approved=true, the exact approval_v3 selected as session, the same idempotency_key, a caller-local session token, and verification_context copied from the selected quote/public wallets. Example: validate and pass the exact conte

tools.name: assetfare_v2_session_get
tools.description: Read an existing v2 workflow without advancing it. Example: pass session_id, session_token, and the original verification_context after restart. The adapter deeply verifies any current_action and emits a self-verifying wallet handoff, or fails closed. Read-only; never signs or submits.

tools.name: assetfare_v2_session_observe_source
tools.description: Record source hashes the caller already signed and submitted, then advance the workflow. Example: pass one finalized source hash, a new idempotency key, and the original verification_context. Any next current_action is deeply verified and receives a wallet handoff. AssetFare never signs or submits.

tools.name: assetfare_v2_session_observe_output
tools.description: Record an already-produced bridge or destination output, then advance the workflow. Example: pass the output hash, a new idempotency key, and the original verification_context. Any next current_action is deeply verified and receives a wallet handoff. AssetFare never signs or submits.

tools.name: assetfare_v2_session_refresh_action
tools.description: Refresh an expired action only while it remains unsubmitted. Example: pass the existing session, a new idempotency key, and the original verification_context. The refreshed action is deeply verified and receives a wallet handoff. Never refresh a submitted step; AssetFare never signs or submits.
